Ricardo, how do you get to work?
Not by car? Here in Miami everybody drives.
The traffic on the street is bad. Two hours by car.
Two hours? And by train?
One hour and ten minutes, from Santana to Vila Olímpia.
And the station? Is it near your office?
Yes. The station is near my office. Five minutes on foot.

Good morning. This is Santana Station, Line 1, Blue. The next train to Paraíso is in four minutes. Please keep your ticket in your hand. At Paraíso, change to Line 2, Green. This station opens at four thirty in the morning and closes at midnight. Thank you, and have a good trip.

Hi Ricardo, this is Paul Adams. One thing about Miami: it is very different from São Paulo. Here most people go to work by car. There is a small train in the center, the Metromover, and it is free. Our office is on Brickell Avenue, near the water. The traffic on the street is bad at six in the evening, so we start early. Talk to you on Monday.
I walk to Santana Station in the morning. I take the subway on Line 1. At Paraíso I change to Line 2. Then I take the train to Vila Olímpia. The station is near my office.
